en.bdb: One's own means are of no avail for liberation

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੜੀਂ ਬੂਟੀਂ ਜੇ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਕਿਉ ਮਰੈ ਧਨੰਤਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: jaRee(n) booTee(n) je jeeveeaai kiau marai dhana(n)taru|

en.bdb: If herbal medicines could keep one alive, why did Dhanvantri (the father of Indian system of medicine) die?

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੰਤੁ ਮੰਤੁ ਬਾਜੀਗਰਾਂ ਓਇ ਭਵਹਿ ਦਿਸੰਤਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: ta(n)t ma(n)t baajeegaraa(n) oi bhaveh dhisa(n)taru|

en.bdb: Conjurers know many tantras and mantras yet they roam about hither and thither in the country.
If worship of trees could make it available, why should trees themselves get burnt (by their own fire)?

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਵੀਰਾਰਾਧੁ ਕਰਿ ਠਗ ਚੋਰ ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: milai na veeraaraadh kar Thag chor na a(n)taru|

en.bdb: Adoration of evil and ferocious spirits also does not bring liberation because there is no basic difference between a thief and a cheat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲੈ ਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਾਗਿਆਂ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਭਵੰਤਰੁ।
verses.translit_en: milai na raatee jaagiaa(n) aparaadh bhava(n)taru|

en.bdb: Liberation cannot be attained through sleepless nights because criminals too remain awake at night wandering here and there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅਮਰੰਤਰੁ ॥੧੫॥
verses.translit_en: vin gur mukat na hoviee gurmukh amara(n)tar ||15||

en.bdb: Without Guru no liberation is achieved and the Guru-oriented, gutmulchs become immortal and make others so too.
